# Incident Response

## Severity levels

A severity one incident means the customer-facing platform is down. The on-call engineer must acknowledge the page within seven minutes. A severity three incident is handled during normal working hours.

## Declaring an incident

Declare an incident by typing the slash command /outage in the team chat. When unsure about severity, choose the higher level.

## Reviews

Every severity one incident gets a written review within five working days.
